Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 0
Reason for Mistake: Misinterpretation of an ambiguous acronym. The agent incorrectly defined "AAS" as "Amino Acid Supplements" in the context of bodybuilding. In the fitness and bodybuilding domain, "AAS" is the standard abbreviation for "Anabolic-Androgenic Steroids," which are performance-enhancing drugs often used in bodybuilding. Amino acid supplements are typically referred to as EAAs, BCAAs, or simply "amino acids." The agent failed to recognize the specific domain context (bodybuilding) which strongly points to steroids rather than amino acids, leading to a factually incorrect definition.
